fields.label: Sub-Assembly BOM
fields.description: The sub-assembly BOM this operation's labor/overhead was pulled in from, if any. Set automatically when loading operations from a BOM; used to group the Operations list (and the Job Cards created from it) by sub-assembly on screen. Blank for operations defined directly on the Work Order's own top-level BOM. Hidden -- not meant for manual editing.

fields.label: Sub-Assembly Production Item
fields.description: The item this operation's sub-assembly actually produces, if any (blank for the Work Order's own top-level/final-assembly operations). Set automatically alongside Sub-Assembly BOM. Used so a Job Card for this row can show what it's producing instead of the Work Order's unrelated finished item.

fields.label: Sub-Assembly Production Qty
fields.description: How much of Sub-Assembly Production Item this Work Order actually requires (0 for the Work Order's own top-level/final-assembly operations). Set automatically alongside Sub-Assembly BOM. Used to default a Job Card's For Quantity to the sub-assembly's own production qty rather than the Work Order's total.
